refinement_plan_1.analysis: Review feedback highlights four main areas for improvement: (1) HIGH: Add General Class Axioms (GCAs) and equivalence axioms, e.g., define Buyer as an Organization with AgentRole 'BY' and InvoiceParticipation in an InvoiceMessage. (2) MEDIUM: Add more disjointness axioms among EDIFACT technical classes (Message, Section, Segment, LineItem) to prevent modeling errors. (3) MEDIUM: Expand technical vocabulary for EDIFACT segment/element codes and mappings (e.g., explicit BGM/NAD code values, D96A mappings). (4) LOW: Add usage examples and rdfs:seeAlso links to external standards for key classes. All CQs are fully covered, so focus is on reasoning power, consistency, and documentation. No constraint violations or coverage gaps found. PLAN: 1.
